articles.summary: Old Republic Title, a 118-year-old institution and one of the industry’s largest and most venerated underwriters, has launched the first phase of moving its direct operations onto Qualia’s cloud-based, AI-powered platform.
articles.title: Old Republic Title Goes Live on Qualia, Marking a New Enterprise Standard for Title & Escrow

articles.summary: Our parent Company, Old Republic International Corporation (NYSE: ORI), announced on February 27, 2026, that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of 31.5 cents per share.
articles.title: Old Republic International Declares First Quarter Regular Cash Dividend
